meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md,让编码助手一进门就懂项目结构和约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次都要向 AI 编码助手重复交代项目结构和命令
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep re-explaining project structure and commands to AI coding agents

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描项目结构、命令和约定,在根目录和经过复杂度评分的子目录里生成一套分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库文件,供 agent 阅读。默认更新已有文件并在需要处新建。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定写成文档给 agent 用时触发;也可直接输入 /init-deep 命令接管,默认更新模式、目录深度限制为 3。

say.text: /init-deep 扫描这个项目,生成分层的 AGENTS.md
say.note: 先写根目录,再并行生成子目录

say.text: /init-deep --create-new 先读现有文件再全部重写
say.note: 读取后删除并重新生成

howto.what_en: Claude scans a repo's structure, commands, and conventions, then writes a hierarchical set of AGENTS.md files at the root and in complexity-scored subdirectories. By default it updates existing files and creates new ones where warranted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents, or when you run the /init-deep command. Default mode updates existing files with max depth 3.

say_en.text: /init-deep — scan this project and generate hierarchical AGENTS.md files
say_en.note: Root first, then subdirectories in parallel

say_en.text: /init-deep --max-depth=2 — only cover the top two directory levels
/init-deep --create-new — read existing files, then regenerate all
say_en.note: Existing content is read before deletion
